_doc: Lagu unit (SP 7.1.1-7.1.6). Draf: python tools/songs/make_song.py games/T1-U07-magnet female|male -> songs_draft/. lyrics = ejaan betul (dipaparkan kepada murid); sung = ejaan sebutan Malaysia untuk penyanyi AI (akhiran -a dibaca 'e': kita -> kite), supaya tidak berbunyi Indonesia.
title: Lagu Magnet
caption: slow gentle Malaysian children's song, sung in Malay with a Malaysian accent (not Indonesian), {voice}, simple repetitive nursery-rhyme melody with few notes, easy for 7-year-olds to sing along, soft acoustic guitar, glockenspiel, light hand claps, warm and cheerful, major key, clear slow diction

voices.female: warm clear female voice, Malaysian kindergarten teacher
voices.male: friendly clear male voice, Malaysian primary school teacher

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Magnet bar, magnet ladam
Bentuk U, butang, cincin
Ada juga yang silinder
Namanya ikut bentuknya!

[Chorus]
Magnet, magnet, tarik, tarik!
Paku, skru, klip, kunci besi
Pensel, guli, pemadam tidak
Magnet hebat, jom kita uji!

[Verse 2]
Kutub utara, kutub selatan
Kutub berlainan tarik-menarik
Kutub yang sama tolak-menolak
Dekatkan, lihat, cuba fikir!

[Chorus]
Magnet, magnet, tarik, tarik!
Paku, skru, klip, kunci besi
Pensel, guli, pemadam tidak
Magnet hebat, jom kita uji!

[Outro]
Peti sejuk, tanda nama
Magnet berguna setiap hari!
